findings.title: Invalid successful-child probe receipt leaves stopped worker labelled PROBE_RUNNING
findings.trigger: The probe process exits 0, but one of the two existing qualification predicates is false.
findings.observed_evidence: Existing invalid_probe host fixture saves status PROBE_RUNNING, probe phase COMPLETE with actual_exit_code 0, and no full20 phase. The existing test expects AssertionError and verifies that full20 is absent.
findings.impact: The stopped branch has stale status. Full training remains blocked, and the main records the worker nonzero exit after branch joins finish.
findings.minimal_fix: Replace only the two validation assertions with the identical predicates and an explicit failure branch that saves FAILED_PROBE_QUALIFICATION and returns 1. Preserve the actual probe-child exit code 0.
findings.requested_check: Extend the existing invalid-probe host case to require return 1, FAILED_PROBE_QUALIFICATION, probe actual_exit_code 0, and no full20 launch.
